variants.headline: Looking back: building project badly behind schedule
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: The project {project} was badly behind schedule.

Workers know that a timetable can be treated as somebody else's promise and somebody else's problem. Labour should resist any account that makes ordinary people invisible in the question of delivery. A serious delay warrants attention without assuming that workers caused it or that speed should override decent conditions.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

The stewardship of {target} warrants scrutiny against the severe delay. This report does not assign an unreported cause or presume that lateness means the project has been abandoned rather than delayed.

variants.headline: Looking back: construction timetable falls seriously short
variants.sub: The project {project} has fallen badly behind its schedule.
variants.body:
Looking back to {first_reported}, this was the news: Construction on {project} was severely delayed.

Workers know that a timetable can be treated as somebody else's promise and somebody else's problem. Labour should resist any account that makes ordinary people invisible in the question of delivery. A serious delay warrants attention without assuming that workers caused it or that speed should override decent conditions.

Time changes the distance from an event, not the need to judge it carefully. Any claim about improvement or deterioration needs more than a recollection of the original news.

The stewardship of {target} warrants scrutiny against the severe delay. This report does not assign an unreported cause or presume that lateness means the project has been abandoned rather than delayed.

variants.headline: Looking back: a project waits beyond its schedule
variants.sub: The project {project} is badly behind schedule.
variants.body:
The headline belongs to {first_reported}. Our original account recorded this: The project {project} had fallen badly behind its schedule.

Workers know that a timetable can be treated as somebody else's promise and somebody else's problem. Labour should resist any account that makes ordinary people invisible in the question of delivery. A serious delay warrants attention without assuming that workers caused it or that speed should override decent conditions.

What has changed since then should be examined against that original record. What has not changed is the need to distinguish an established event from the hopes or fears attached to it.

The stewardship of {target} warrants scrutiny against the severe delay. This report does not assign an unreported cause or presume that lateness means the project has been abandoned rather than delayed.
